card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way, 98 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 19.7 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, RU Sct: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 97.8 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 1,798 parsecs away.
